framing.title: Before we begin
framing.body:
You are the THIRD PERSON in this conversation: two people are talking, and you are standing with them.
Listen as you would in real life. You will not need to speak.
After each conversation you will be asked a few questions; please say your answers out loud.
There are {0} groups * {1} versions.

Next: questions preview.

perClipItems.text: The characters' eye movements looked natural.
The characters' eye movements around the speaker changes felt well-timed.
The characters looked at each other as if they were paying attention to each other.
The characters' eye movements showed that they were aware I was there.

ranking.prompt: Rank the three versions by how natural the characters' eye movements were, fill them from best to worst.

comment.prompt: Did any version feel uncomfortable or unsettling to watch? Which, and why? (optional)
